result.title: AI for Detection and Response | Cloudflare’s Mark Anderson
result.description: Security teams face a constant stream of vulnerabilities and alerts. Cloudflare’s Mark Anderson describes using AI to automate detection and response so experts can focus on threats that need their judgment. He sees automation from companies like OpenAI as a way to take on routine security work and help teams keep pace.
